verificationType: Targeted official/primary technical checks; no wholesale external-text reproduction.

sources.title: OpenAI voice agents guide
sources.support: The official guide separates chained workflows with inspectable/replaceable intermediate text from speech-to-speech paths and calls for audible latency, interruption, task and transport evaluation.
sources.limit: Architecture guidance, not a universal latency benchmark or fixed topology requirement.

sources.title: OpenAI Realtime conversations: Interruption and Truncation
sources.support: Generation cancellation, stopping playback and removing unplayed conversation material are distinct; ownership differs between WebSocket and WebRTC/SIP.
sources.limit: The answer stays protocol-neutral; exact event names and behavior must be checked for the selected provider/version.

sources.title: LayoutLMv3: Pre-training for Document AI with Unified Text and Image Masking
sources.support: Original paper uses unified text/image pretraining and word-patch alignment for document tasks, supporting the distinction between text and visual correspondence.
sources.limit: A model example; not proof that every VLM reliably returns coordinates or that OCR-first always wins.

sources.title: Multimodal Machine Learning: A Survey and Taxonomy
sources.support: Authors distinguish representation, alignment and fusion as separate challenges and go beyond a simple early/late taxonomy.
sources.limit: The early/middle/late terminology is an explanatory convention, not a universal architecture standard.

editorialOrDerivedClaims: Nonadditive quantiles and overlapped critical paths are mathematical/system-timing reasoning already present in the original.
Evidence provenance, permissions, minimal retention, fallback and side-effect isolation are application requirements, not claimed benchmark findings.
No source establishes a universal best OCR/VLM route or universal end-to-end speech latency improvement.
